name: Text Art
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Your image, rebuilt from characters, things and ink - a whole shelf of cards, computed in your browser and sorted into four groups. FROM CHARACTERS: ASCII ART with charsets (classic, blocks, braille, binary, Matrix rain, typewriter, your own characters), EMOJI ART with coverage-weighted color matching, a WORD PORTRAIT that grows and rotates your words with the image, readable LYRICS and POST ART flows (rows, diagonal, waves, spiral - straight from a WordPress post) and SILHOUETTE TEXT. MOSAICS FROM THINGS: BRICK ART (classic toy-brick palette or original colors), DICE ART (white and black dice carrying the grays in their pips), CUBE ART (sticker colors with the face grid), STICKY NOTES, DOT MATRIX (LED wall, flip-dot display or pegboard), MARQUEE LIGHTS, CERAMIC MOSAIC, KEYCAP ART, STAMP WALL (perforated stamps each carrying their crop of the picture), BOTTLE CAPS, COIN MOSAIC (bronze in the shadows, gold in the lights), BUTTON MOSAIC, DOMINO ART, PLAYING CARDS (more pips where the picture is darker, picture cards and face-down cards in the deepest shadows, hearts and diamonds where it is warm), PUSH PINS on cork, a QR PORTRAIT that hides the photo inside a working, scannable QR code, and YOUR TILE - any layer of your document, your logo included, becomes the mosaic stone. DRAWN WITH INK, and able to leave as vector paths instead of pixels: an ENGRAVING whose lines swell instead of darkening, CONTOUR LINES, STIPPLE, ONE LINE in continuous-line styles (spiral, spiral waves, meander, waves, labyrinth and a free line), STRING ART - one thread wound from nail to nail around a round board until the portrait appears in its crossings, or several colored threads wound over each other, their colors picked from the image or set by you - and a MORSE PORTRAIT whose dots and dashes spell your message and swell with the picture. WITHOUT A PHOTO: ELEMENT ART periodic tiles (BaCoN style), HIDDEN WORDS letter grids, crossing LETTER TILES with letter values, a RANSOM NOTE with every letter cut from a different magazine, and a WORD CLOUD packed by real word frequency - from your own words or a post, into a heart, a star or any letter. Shape masks (heart, star, circle, diamond, a giant letter or any emoji) replace the photo anywhere. Every card is drawn again at the size it takes in your document, so letters and edges stay sharp, and every artwork exports as a REVEAL ANIMATION - the picture builds itself piece by piece, encoded frame by frame as a video, to download or straight to the Media Library. Everything inserts as an editable layer and reopens with all settings.
